From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Redwood x Acme Commerce

Thanks again for taking the time today, Sophie — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Call recap:
- Primary use case: site search reranking + personalized recommendations for checkout flow (targeting 95th pctl latency < 250ms for search).
- Key decision criteria: latency, predictable unit cost at scale, data controls (VPC/KMS), and SOC2 readiness.
- Primary technical eval: pilot on a subset of catalog queries + 1 week perf run.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Stakeholder mapping: could you share a short org chart or list of decision-makers across Product, Procurement, Security, and Legal? Specifically looking for the economic buyer and who owns procurement/contract review.
2) Security/compliance contacts: we'll need an initial contact for InfoSec to start the questionnaire and share our SOC2/pen test artifacts.
3) Procurement timeline: any procurement cadence or blackout dates we should know about?

We attached a short one-pager and SOW outline for legal/procurement review. If it's helpful, we'd love intros to the procurement and InfoSec contacts so we can coordinate next steps — happy to join a joint call. Proposed time for a follow-up: Wed 7/14 or Thu 7/15, 10–12 PT.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (product summary), redwood-sow-outline.docx (SOW outline)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

On a related note, cc'ing Neha (security lead) and Lukas (solutions engineer) so they can prep the compliance checklist and a target pilot plan once we have the stakeholders.

Hi all — thanks, Marissa and Sophie. Wed 7/14 11:00 PT works for me for a joint intro (we can run 30-45 min). A couple of procurement notes up front: 

- For pilot projects, procurement typically requests a 3-month evaluation term with an optional renewal; we'll want clear success metrics tied to cost/latency improvements.
- Please include sample MSA terms and an initial SOW that matches the pilot scope (Marissa: I saw the procurement-packet.zip attachment — will review).
- Primary contracting constraints: data residency clause and liability cap are hot buttons for Legal; we'll escalate those once Legal is on the thread.

Tom — can you confirm the InfoSec pre-reqs you'd like before the call? If you can flag any must-have artifacts (e.g., pen-test report, data flow diagrams), that'd be helpful so Redwood can bring them to the meeting.

Looking forward to the call — Nina
